changes.to: Maker parameter table (glroad.com, 劳动者M1): height 187 cm, mass 86 kg, dual-arm payload 50 kg (combined, test conditions not stated), moving speed >1.2 m/s (field = 1.2 m/s, lower bound), battery 22 Ah (voltage not published), runtime 2 h, 27 whole-body DoF (6 per leg, 1 head; the table's single-arm figure is inconsistent with the maker's own diagram showing 7-DoF arms), peak joint torque 430 N.m, dual encoders, arm-end accuracy printed illegibly on the page. Released 20 Aug 2026 with the C1. C1 is a different, much smaller robot.
Glroad's heavy-load biped industrial humanoid (1.87 m, 86 kg) with a 50 kg dual-arm rating, billed as the industry's first 50 kg-class humanoid.
